description: This is a C source file implementing core functions for the PTM driver specific to the AR9 platform, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and register access functions.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version major and minor numbers.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes hardware components for the PTM chip.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_uninit_chip
methods.description: Uninitializes hardware components for the PTM chip.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Downloads and starts the PP32 firmware.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_proc_read_regs
methods.description: Reads and outputs current register states for debugging.
